The Authentic Name

Why skr.com is the correct form

Hieroglyphs

𓋴𓎡𓂋𓅃

The name in its original Hieroglyphs form. 𓋴𓎡𓂋𓅃 → Skr. Hieroglyphic spelling 𓋴𓎡𓂋𓅃 generated from MdC s-k:r-G5 · Read in scholarly transliteration as Skr · The mysterious one

ASCII Constraint

SOKAR

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Skr

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
skr.com → skr.com

The non-ASCII characters in Skr are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Skr.

Tier Classification

Why Skr is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Egyptian form 𓋴𓎡𓂋𓅃 preserves neither stress nor length in this Unicode restoration. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 Basic name — still a scholarly step above plain ASCII, but without the distinctive phonetic features that define higher tiers.
